# Initiative: Core Booking Platform

## Overview
Implement the foundational booking and quote management system that enables service businesses to manage appointments and provide quotes to customers.

## Goals
- Establish a robust appointment scheduling system
- Create quote generation and management capabilities
- Implement core business logic for service management
- Ensure system is extensible for future enhancements

## Success Metrics
- Successfully process end-to-end booking flow
- Generate and manage quotes
- System response time under 500ms for core operations
- 95% test coverage for core functionality

## Timeline
- Estimated Duration: 12 weeks
- Priority: P0 (Critical Path)

## Dependencies
- None (Initial Initiative)

## Risks
- Complex business logic integration
- Data model scalability
- Integration points with external calendar systems
- Performance at scale
